# **TASK 1**

##  **Hotel Reservation Website Interface** 

### **Aim**

To design and develop a personal portfolio website using HTML and CSS to display a profile, educational qualifications, technical skills, hobbies, projects, achievements, resume, and contact information. To implement CSS animations, responsive layouts, and interactive navigation effects to make the website attractive and user-friendly.

### **Source Code**

\<\!DOCTYPE html\>

\<html\>

\<head\>

    \<title\>Hotel Reservation\</title\>

    \<style\>

        body {

            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;

            margin: 0;

            background: \#f2f2f2;

        }

        header {

            background: \#173f5f;

            color: white;

            text-align: center;

            padding: 20px;

        }

        nav {

            background: \#20639b;

            text-align: center;

            padding: 12px;

        }

        nav a {

            color: white;

            text-decoration: none;

            margin: 15px;

        }

        h2 {

            text-align: center;

            color: \#173f5f;

        }

        .rooms {

            display: flex;

            justify-content: center;

            flex-wrap: wrap;

            gap: 20px;

            padding: 20px;

        }

        .card {

            background: white;

            width: 280px;

            text-align: center;

            border-radius: 10px;

            box-shadow: 0 0 8px gray;

            padding-bottom: 15px;

        }

        .card img {

            width: 100%;

            height: 180px;

            border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0;

        }

        .card p {

            color: \#555;

        }

        .booking {

            background: white;

            max-width: 400px;

            margin: 20px auto;

            padding: 20px;

            border-radius: 10px;

        }

        input, select, button {

            width: 100%;

            padding: 10px;

            margin: 8px 0;

            box-sizing: border-box;

        }

        button {

            background: \#20639b;

            color: white;

            border: none;

            cursor: pointer;

        }

        button:hover {

            background: \#173f5f;

        }

        footer {

            background: \#173f5f;

            color: white;

            text-align: center;

            padding: 15px;

        }

    \</style\>

\</head\>

\<body\>

    \<header\>

        \<h1\>Dream Stay Hotel\</h1\>

        \<p\>Enjoy Your Comfortable Stay\</p\>

    \</header\>

    \<nav\>

        \<a href\="\#home"\>Home\</a\>

        \<a href\="\#rooms"\>Rooms\</a\>

        \<a href\="\#booking"\>Booking\</a\>

        \<a href\="\#contact"\>Contact\</a\>

    \</nav\>

    \<section id\="home"\>

        \<h2\>Welcome to Our Hotel\</h2\>

        \<p style\="text-align:center;"\>

            We provide comfortable rooms and excellent facilities.

        \</p\>

    \</section\>

    \<section id\="rooms"\>

        \<h2\>Our Room Categories\</h2\>

        \<div class\="rooms"\>

            \<div class\="card"\>

                \<img src\="https\://images.unsplash.com/photo-1611892440504-42a792e24d32"

                     alt\="Deluxe Room"\>

                \<h3\>Deluxe Room\</h3\>

                \<p\>Free Wi-Fi, AC and TV\</p\>

                \<h3\>₹2000 / Night\</h3\>

            \</div\>

            \<div class\="card"\>

                \<img src\="https\://images.unsplash.com/photo-1590490360182-c33d57733427"

                     alt\="Luxury Room"\>

                \<h3\>Luxury Room\</h3\>

                \<p\>AC, Wi-Fi and Room Service\</p\>

                \<h3\>₹3500 / Night\</h3\>

            \</div\>

            \<div class\="card"\>

                \<img src\="https\://images.unsplash.com/photo-1582719478250-c89cae4dc85b"

                     alt\="Suite Room"\>

                \<h3\>Suite Room\</h3\>

                \<p\>King Bed, AC and Balcony\</p\>

                \<h3\>₹5000 / Night\</h3\>

            \</div\>

        \</div\>

    \</section\>

    \<section id\="booking"\>

        \<h2\>Book Your Room\</h2\>

        \<div class\="booking"\>

            \<form\>

                \<label\>Full Name:\</label\>

                \<input type\="text" placeholder\="Enter your name" required\>

                \<label\>Email:\</label\>

                \<input type\="email" placeholder\="Enter your email" required\>

                \<label\>Room Type:\</label\>

                \<select required\>

                    \<option\>Deluxe Room\</option\>

                    \<option\>Luxury Room\</option\>

                    \<option\>Suite Room\</option\>

                \</select\>

                \<label\>Check-in Date:\</label\>

                \<input type\="date" required\>

                \<label\>Check-out Date:\</label\>

                \<input type\="date" required\>

                \<label\>Number of Guests:\</label\>

               \<input type\="number" min\="1" placeholder\="Guests" required\>

                \<button type\="submit"\>Reserve Now\</button\>

            \</form\>

        \</div\>

    \</section\>

    \<footer id\="contact"\>

        \<p\>Contact: dreamstay@gmail.com\</p\>

        \<p\>© 2026 Dream Stay Hotel\</p\>

    \</footer\>

\</body\>

\</html\>

### **Output**

![][image1]

### **Conclusion**

Thus, the Hotel Reservation Website was successfully designed using HTML and internal CSS. The website displays room details, facilities, tariffs, and a reservation form with a simple and attractive layout. It also provides a responsive design for different screen sizes.

\<\!DOCTYPE html\>  
\<html\>  
\<head\>  
    \<title\>Online Food Ordering\</title\>  
    \<style\>  
        body {  
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;  
            margin: 0;  
            background: \#fff8f0;  
        }  
        header {  
            background: \#e85d04;  
            color: white;  
            text-align: center;  
            padding: 20px;  
        }  
        nav {  
            background: \#333;  
            text-align: center;  
            padding: 12px;  
        }  
        nav a {  
            color: white;  
            text-decoration: none;  
            margin: 15px;  
        }  
        h2 {  
            text-align: center;  
            color: \#e85d04;  
        }  
        .offer {  
            background: \#ffdd99;  
            text-align: center;  
            padding: 15px;  
            margin: 20px;  
            border-radius: 10px;  
        }  
        .menu {  
            display: flex;  
            justify-content: center;  
            flex-wrap: wrap;  
            gap: 20px;  
            padding: 20px;  
        }  
        .card {  
            background: white;  
            width: 250px;  
            text-align: center;  
            border-radius: 10px;  
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px gray;  
            padding-bottom: 15px;  
        }  
        .card img {  
            width: 100%;  
            height: 180px;  
            border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0;  
        }  
        .card p {  
            color: \#555;  
        }  
        button {  
            background: \#e85d04;  
            color: white;  
            border: none;  
            padding: 10px 20px;  
            cursor: pointer;  
            border-radius: 5px;  
        }  
        button:hover {  
            background: \#b83b00;  
        }  
        .reviews {  
            background: \#ffe8d6;  
            text-align: center;  
            padding: 20px;  
        }  
        footer {  
            background: \#333;  
            color: white;  
            text-align: center;  
            padding: 15px;  
        }  
        @media (max-width: 600px) {  
            nav a {  
                display: inline-block;  
                margin: 8px;  
            }

                width: 90%;  
            }  
        }  
    \</style\>  
\</head\>  
\<body\>

        \<a href\="\#reviews"\>Reviews\</a\>

    \<section id\="home"\>

        \<p style\="text-align:center;"\>  
            Fresh, tasty and delicious food for everyone\!  
        \</p\>  
    \</section\>  
    \<section id\="offers"\>  
        \<div class\="offer"\>  
            \<h2\>Special Offer\!\</h2\>  
            \<p\>Get 20% OFF on your first order.\</p\>

    \</section\>  
    \<section id\="menu"\>  
        \<h2\>Our Food Menu\</h2\>  
        \<div class\="menu"\>  
            \<div class\="card"\>  
                \<img src\="https\://images.unsplash.com/photo-1568901346375-23c9450c58cd"  
                     alt\="Burger"\>  
                \<h3\>Burger\</h3\>  
                \<p\>Category: Fast Food\</p\>  
                \<p\>₹120\</p\>  
                \<button\>Order Now\</button\>  
            \</div\>  
            \<div class\="card"\>  
                \<img src\="https\://images.unsplash.com/photo- pizza"  
                     alt\="Pizza"\>  
                \<h3\>Pizza\</h3\>  
                \<p\>Category: Italian\</p\>  
                \<p\>₹250\</p\>  
                \<button\>Order Now\</button\>  
            \</div\>  
            \<div class\="card"\>  
                \<img src\="https\://images.unsplash.com/photo-1512058564366-18510be2db19"  
                     alt\="Biryani"\>  
                \<h3\>Chicken Biryani\</h3\>

                \<p\>₹180\</p\>  
                \<button\>Order Now\</button\>  
            \</div\>  
            \<div class\="card"\>  
                \<img src\="https\://images.unsplash.com/photo-1563805042-7684c019e1cb"  
                     alt\="Ice Cream"\>  
                \<h3\>Ice Cream\</h3\>  
                \<p\>Category: Desserts\</p\>  
                \<p\>₹80\</p\>  
                \<button\>Order Now\</button\>

    \<section id\="reviews"\>  
        \<div class\="reviews"\>  
            \<h2\>Customer Reviews\</h2\>  
            \<p\>Excellent food and fast delivery\!\</p\>  
            \<p\>Great taste and friendly service\!\</p\>  
        \</div\>  
    \</section\>  
    \<footer\>  
        \<p\>Contact: foodies@gmail.com\</p\>  
        \<p\>© 2026 Foodie's Restaurant\</p\>  
    \</footer\>  
\</body\>  
\</html\>

### \<\!DOCTYPE html\>
